title: Talk of the Teahouse
description: Renown Level: 15 Patron: Heartstruck Dowager "Your merry band of outlaws and its dashing deeds of derring-do are all the talk amongst the ladies of the court. We have gathered together several items of worth, that you might continue on your gallantry." Crate Contents: - 400 Ability Points - Valley Madder x 20 - Bloody Hide x 20 - Steelsilk x 20

title: Respect
description: Renown Level: 45 Patron: The Bloodaxes "Our order is one built on pride, but that does not mean we are too proud to give thanks where thanks is due. We may gave failed Martha once, but never again." Crate Contents: - Meteorite x 1

title: Pillow Talk
description: Renown Level: 85 Patron: A Busy Courtesan "Such is the renown of Cid the Outlaw, that much of my clientele would rather spend their time prattling on about _your_ endeavors than making any endeavors of their own. For that, I feel I owe you a least a portion of my earnings. A particularly enamored sort left this on my nightstand. May it serve you better than it did him." Crate Contents: - Berserker Ring (Accessory)

title: A Swelling Chorus
description: Renown Level: 135 Patron: Merry Mummer "It used to be I would step into a tavern only to find myself overwhelmed with requests to sing of Dion the Bold or the Coerul and the Serving Girl. But now, all anyone wants to hear of is Cid the Outlaw. You have made me a very rich man, my friend." Crate Contents: - [A Rose is a Rose](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286828) (Orchestrion Roll) - Empty Shard x 1

title: A Prayer for Safe Travels
description: Renown Level: 205 Patron: A Concerned Caravaneer "They say it is your men who keep the roads free of beast and bandit. As one whose livelihood is reliant on safe passage from market to market, my chocobos and I thank you." Crate Contents: - Cleric's Medallion +1 (Accessory)

title: Safe Passage
description: Renown Level: 295 Patron: Traveling Terpsichorean "Not long ago, I was accosted by footpads as I walked the Gilded Path, and would have perished alone in the desert had not the Cursebreakers come to my aid. I owe them my life. May this token serve them well." Crate Contents: - Dire Wolf Jess (Accessory)

title: A Token
description: Renown Level: 410 Patron: A Nameless Patron "Many claim they wish to change the world. Few actually take it upon themselves to do so. You are an inspiration to use all." Crate Contents: - 800 Ability Points - Briar Clam Shell x 25 - Desert Rose x 15

title: The Bearer's Plight
description: Renown Level: 550 Patron: A Friend in Northreach "Few are those who would strive to lighten the burden borne by the crystals' curse, but if we are to survive the coming storm, we must stand together—Bearer and Brother—as you have shown us." Crate Contents: - Meteorite x 2

title: A Light from the Heavens
description: Renown Level: 715 Patron: A Humble Servant "The goddess Greagor teaches us that to walk with the wretched is an act of greater good. If we are to accept this truth, then one could not rightly call he who follows this path an 'outlaw'." Crate Contents: - High Cleric's Medallion (Accessory)

title: A Pall Lifted
description: Renown Level: 905 Patron: Dalimil Spicer "Hugo's men are gone, and with them the fear in our hearts. Once more shall the markets echo with mirth and merriment. And it is you who we have to thank." Crate Contents: - 1500 Ability Points - Sharp Fang x 40 - Bloody Hide x 30 - Steelsilk x 30

title: Newfound Purpose
description: Renown Level: 1120 Patron: A Lonely Porter "Since I can remember, I have served none but myself—turned my back on the world for a handful of silks and a heavy purse. But where has that left me? It is hard to keep joy in one's heart when all those around you are without. Something must change. And that change myst start with me." Crate Contents: - [No Risk, No Reward](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286836) (Orchestrion Roll) - Amber x 1

title: A Gift
description: Renown Level: 1360 Patron: The Chapman "Enclosed you will find an item of high and strange order—one for which I require neither thanks nor recompense. Consider it a reminder of where loyalties are best placed." Crate Contents: - Talisman of Priming (Accessory)

title: A Fitting Performance
description: Renown Level: 1635 Patron: Viktor "Natalie reports an unexpected surplus in Dalimil's stores, and, as means of showing the town's gratitude for past assistance, has expressed her distinct wish that one... 'Lord Underhill' partake in their good fortune." Crate Contents: - 2500 Ability Points - Clutchmine x 20 - Wyrrite x 50 - Magicked Ash x 50

title: Faith Undying
description: Renown Level: 1965 Patron: The Undying "We are the shadows that wicked in the firebird's wake, and from the shadows do serve our lord and those who would His wings." Crate Contents: - Ring of the Swiftshot (Accessory)

title: Continental Acclaim
description: Renown Level: 2365 Patron: Gerath "If the drunken galley captain I shared a table with last night is to be believed, word of your exploits has made its way across the seas to the Great Continent. What is more, she claims there are those who would see you flourish—herself being one such woman." Crate Contents: - Genji Gloves (Accessory)

title: Unsigned
description: Renown Level: 2850 Patron: Unsigned "Every epic starts with a single word. Every symphony, a single note. This is but the beginning, and fore'er shall your legend be told. Fore'er shall your legacy be sung." Crate Contents: - [To Sail Forbidden Seas](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286855) (Orchestrion Roll) - Fallen Enigma x 1

title: Use Your Loaf
description: Story Progress Required: Out of the Shadow Quest Giver: Matej, Master Baker A baker in Dalimil asks Clive to track down his missing apprentice, who can apparently often be found mooning at what remains of Drake’s Fang. Rewards: - 300 Experience - 320 Ability Points - 800 Gil - 10 Renown - Goblin Coin x 1

title: Payback
description: Story Progress Required: Out of the Shadow Quest Giver: Read "Off the Record" missive from Gaute at the [Reading Table](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286799). A cursory review of the Hideway’s ledgers by Gaute has revealed an issue of utmost concern so concerning, in fact, that he wishes to speak with Clive about it personally. Rewards: - 130 Experience - 20 Renown - [Cid's Goblet](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287561) (Memory Item) - Wyrrite x 25 - Sharp Fang x 50 - Meteorite x 1

title: A Bone to Pick
description: Story Progress Required: Out of the Shadow Quest Giver: Read "A Bad Feeling..." missive from Charon at the [Reading Table](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286799). Lady Charon is concerned with Torgal’s well-being and wishes to discuss the matter privately. Rewards: - 500 Experience - 800 Gil - 20 Renown - Cavall's Fang (Accessory) - Sharp Fang x 50 Next Side Quest: [More than Words](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286887)

title: Get Cart
description: Story Progress Required: Onward Quest Giver: Jonasz Clive is asked by a pair of mercenaries he meets on the road to Boklad to help them recover a merchant’s missing wagon. Apparently, it may well involve dealing with a gang of bandits. Rewards: - 500 Experience - 800 Gil - 20 Renown - Wyrrite x 80

title: Onward to Discovery
description: Story Progress Required: Onward Quest Giver: Jachym, Scholar An excitable scholar of Dzemekian history hires Clive to watch over him while he investigates some ruins near Boklad, then promptly disappears before his newly hired bodyguard can so much as blink. Rewards: - 900 Experience - 280 Ability Points - 30 Renown - The Breath of the Earth: Upheaval (Accessory) - Wyrrite x 20

title: Live and Let Live
description: Story Progress Required: Onward Quest Giver: Kveta, Porter A porter in Boklad has had her packs ransacked, and seeks someone to go after the sellsword whose help she enlisted to track down the culprits. Rewards: - 900 Experience - 800 Gil - 30 Renown - Wyrrite x 20 - Meteorite x 1

title: Bearer of Good News
description: Story Progress Required: Onward Quest Giver: Ondrej, Tavernkeeper An innkeeper in Boklad asks Clive to deliver the good news to three of his friends about a particularly fine bottle of wine he’s managed to get his hands on. Rewards: - 300 Experience - 15 Renown - Wyrrite x 40 - Black Blood x 1

title: Smooth Like Butler
description: Story Progress Required: Things Fall Apart Quest Giver: Read "A Humble Request" missive from Sebastian Rutherford at the [Reading Table](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286799). Wanting to learn more of the state of the realm following the fall of its Mothercrystals and the darkening of its skies Lord Byron Rosfield does what any man of means might: task one of his servants with the endeavour. That servant, however, now wishes to speak with Clive and urgently requests an audience in Martha’s Rest. Rewards: - 900 Experience - 1000 Gil - 35 Renown - The Breath of Light: Flare Breath (Accessory) - Steelsilk x 25 - Bloody Hide x 25

title: An Eye for an Eye
description: Story Progress Required: Things Fall Apart Quest Giver: Goetz Ill rumours being spread about Lady Charon’s past has poor Goetz worried sick for his Nan. The gentle giant has asked if Clive might discreetly inquire with her about the veracity of said whispers. Rewards: - 900 Experience - 35 Renown - [Continental Cencer](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287572) (Memory Item) - Meteorite x 1

title: Not to Be Outdone
description: Story Progress Required: Things Fall Apart Quest Giver: Molly, Kitchen Head Molly, cauldron keeper at the Fat Chocobo, seeks to recreate an ancient recipe for “fried mortress of skyworm.” Unfortunately, she’s not exactly sure what several of the ingredients are namely drakesmint and skyworm. Rewards: - 700 Experience - 25 Renown - Sharp Fang x 25 - Bloody Hide x 75

title: On Balance
description: Story Progress Required: Things Fall Apart Quest Giver: Shirleigh, Tutor A scale used in one of Miss Shirleigh’s recent lessons has gone missing, and the young instructor is fairly certain her mischievous pupils are behind its untimely disppearence. Rewards: - 900 Experience - 800 Gil - 25 Renown - Black Blood x 1 - Gil Bug x 2

title: Bad Blood
description: Story Progress Required: Cloak and Dagger Quest Giver: Wounded Republican Soldier On the road to Tabor, Clive discovers a gravely wounded republican soldier who tells him of the aetherflood that consumed his unit’s nearby encampment, rendering everyone in it Akashic. With his final breaths, the dying man asks Clive to slay his turned brothers-in-arms that they might not hurt any others. Rewards: - 900 Experience - 25 Renown - Magicked Ash x 100 - Meteorite x 1

title: Skin Trade
description: Story Progress Required: Cloak and Dagger Quest Giver: Karel, Tanner A merchant in Tabor makes Clive an offer he allegedly can’t refuse to hunt a dread aevis and share in the seemingly coniderable profits that its skin will bring when sold. Rewards: - 900 Experience - 25 Renown - Bloody Hide x 100 - Meteorite x 1

title: Carved in Stone
description: Story Progress Required: Cloak and Dagger Quest Giver: Milos, Antiquarian An aging scholar in Tabor asks Clive to go and look at the ancient engravings dotted around town in order to help him uncover the history of the local people. Correct Answers: - “Guardians of the crystal...” - “Wanderers of the golden plains...” - "Children of the hunters, now tillers of the land...” Rewards: - 400 Experience - 1000 Gil - 20 Renown - Goblin Coin x 1

title: For Great Justice II
description: Required: - Story Progress: Cloak and Dagger - Previous Side Quest: [For Great Justice](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287556) Quest Giver: Quinten Quinten asks that Clive take those Bearers who cannot join him on his quest for vengeance into his protection, before he sets out to see justice is done. Rewards: - 1200 Experience - 45 Renown - [Hanged Man Signboard](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287579) (Memory Item) - The Break of Wind: Wicked Wheel (Accessory) - Meteorite x 1

title: Rekindling the Flame
description: Story Progress Required: Cloak and Dagger Quest Giver: Martha Martha and Wade have a plan to relocate the Bearers and Guardians who have lately taken refuge in the Rest to Eastpool their only obstacle, the bandits that have taken up residence there. Rewards: - 700 Experience - 800 Ability Points - 25 Renown - Steelsilk x 40 - Bloody Hide x 80 - Meteorite x 1 Next Side Quest: [Rekindling the Flame II](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287589)

title: Trading Places
description: Story Progress Required: Cloak and Dagger Quest Giver: Eloise Eloise has a plan to purchase a large group of Bearers and relocate them to Kasjlok, where they might live free the only obstacle, the beasts and bogles that have made a nest of the abandoned village. Rewards: - 700 Experience - 1200 Gil - 50 Renown - Wyrrite x 50 - Meteorite x 1 - Black Blood x 1 Next Side Quest: [Trading Places II](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287592)

title: Tears of Mercy
description: Story Progress Required: A Song of Hope Quest Giver: Rodrigue, Physicker Rodrigue begs Clive to help him convince Tarja that she needs to rest. It seems she’s been devoting all her time to a certain patient, and not even stopping to sleep. Rewards: - 400 Experience - 1200 Gil - 25 Renown - Sharp Fang x 20 - Magicked Ash x 40

title: Self-Determination
description: Story Progress Required: Across the Narrow Quest Giver: Quest Giver: Read "Captain Dorys" missive from Cole at the [Reading Table](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286799) Clive receives a letter from Cole expressing his concerns about Dorys’s wellbeing, and reolves to speak with her and see what the trouble might be. Rewards: - 1600 Experience - 30 Renown - Wyrrite x 100 - Sharp Fang x 25 - Meteorite x 1 Next Side Quest: [Nobody's Tool](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286882)

title: Under New Management
description: Story Progress Required: Across the Narrow Quest Giver: Isabelle Isabelle requests that Clive speak with the Duke of Origlamme and convince him of the error of his ways, before his self-interested schemes tear Northreach apart. Rewards: - 2800 Experience - 1500 Gil - 30 Renown - Steelsilk x 15 - Bloody Hide x 15 - Meteorite x 1 Next Side Quest: [Under New Management II](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287587)

title: Under New Management II
description: Required: - Story Progress: Back to Their Origin - Previous Side Quest: [Under New Management](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287586) Quest Giver: Isabelle With the garrison otherwise engaged in refortifying Northreach and rebuilding Caer Norvent, Isabelle fears that the town wants for sentries, and asks Clive to lend Philippe and his newly formed town watch his aid. Rewards: - 7200 Experience - 40 Renown - Orichalcum x 1 - Meteorite x 1 - [Veil Signboard](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287588) (Memory Item)

title: Rekindling the Flame II
description: Required: - Story Progress: Across the Narrow - Previous Side Quest: [Rekindling the Flame](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287580) Quest Giver: Martha Martha asks that Clive deliver some gysahl greens seeds to Wade in Eastpool, that their new settlement might at length become self-sufficient. Rewards: - 4800 Experience - 1200 Gil - 50 Renown - Wyrrite x 100 - Meteorite x 1 - [Martha's Rest Signboard](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287589) (Memory Item)

title: Lines in the Sand
description: Story Progress Required: Across the Narrow Quest Giver: L'ubor L’ubor reports that the bandits who previously attacked Dalimil have formed a “League of Outlaws,” and are steadily recruiting new members. He asks for Clive’s aid in nipping their organising efforts in the bud. Rewards: - 2800 Experience - 30 Renown - Magicked Ash x 120 - Meteorite x 1 Next Side Quest: [Lines in the Sand II](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287607)

title: Trading Places II
description: Required: - Story Progress: Across the Narrow - Previous Side Quest: [Trading Places](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287581) Quest Giver: Theodore The rebuilding and restocking of Kasjlok is well underway, but what of the negotiations with the army? Theodore asks Clive to check in with his sister as to when the purchase is likely to be concluded. Rewards: - 4800 Experience - 400 Ability Points - 1500 Gil - 50 Renown - The Breath of Fire: Scarlet Cyclone (Accessory) - [Crimson Caravans Signboard](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287593) (Memory Item)

title: Duty Undying
description: Story Progress Required: Across the Narrow Quest Giver: Cyril Cyril tells Clive that a team of Undying are conducting a survey of a nearby Fallen ruin as part of their investigations into Ultima, and proposes that he make the short journey to Kretov to observe their work. Rewards: - 2800 Experience - 30 Renown - Breath of Ice: Ice Age (Accessory) Next Side Quest: [Duty Undying II](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287595)

title: Duty Undying II
description: Required: - Story Progress: Back to Their Origin - Previous Side Quest: [Duty Undying](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287594) Quest Giver: Cyril Cyril tells Clive that a high-ranking member of his order, the Third Chair, has gone missing in Ash on another of the Undying’s so-called “surveys.” He directs Clive to Mikkelburg, the acolyte’s last known location. Rewards: - 9600 Experience - 1000 Ability Points - 1500 Gil - 50 Renown - Orichalcum x 1 - [Clayhearth Signboard](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287596) (Memory Item)

title: Laid to Rest
description: Story Progress Required: Brotherhood Quest Giver: Wounded Royalist A dying soldier on the road to Stonhyrr asks Clive to deliver his ring to his parents’ final resting place. The request made, he expires, hopeful that his soul might find peace at last. Rewards: - 2800 Experience - 1200 Gil - 30 Renown - Clutchmine x 20 - Meteorite x 1

title: A Tail to Tell
description: Story Progress Required: Back to Their Origin Quest Giver: Read "Making Amends" missive from Harpocrates at the [Reading Table](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286799). Clive receives a letter from Harpocrates that suggests the historian and Prince Dion have a closer relationship than he knew. He journeys to the shelves in search of answers. Rewards: - 9600 Experience - 30 Renown - Bahamut's Mercy (Accessory) - [Stolas Quill](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287600) (Memory Item)

title: Silver Linings
description: Required: - Story Progress: Back to Their Origin - Previous Side Quest: [Trial and Error](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286881) Quest Giver: [Gav](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286885) Gav has carved a gift for Edda’s unborn child, as is tradition in the Northern Territories, but lacks the final piece required to complete it the feather of a rarely seen silver chocobo. Rewards: - 5600 Experience - 30 Renown - [Winter Mead](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287603) (Memory Item)

title: Priceless
description: Required: - Story Progress: Back to Their Origin - Previous Side Quest: [Where There's a Will](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286883) Quest Giver: Read "Concern for Jill" missive from Joshua at the [Reading Table](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=286799). Joshua is worried that recent events have begun to weigh heavily on Jill and wonders if there is not something he and Clive might do to lift her spirits. Rewards: - 7200 Experience - 40 Renown - [Snow Daisy Garland](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287605) (Memory Item) - Shiva's Kiss (Accessory)

title: Lines in the Sand II
description: Required: - Story Progress: Back to Their Origin - Previous Side Quest: [Lines in the Sand](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287591) Quest Giver: L'ubor L’ubor asks that Clive take the orphans that he has been caring for into his protection. Clive gladly agrees, but as he does so, they hear the horrifying news that a band of Akashic may soon be at Dalimil’s gates. Rewards: - 7200 Experience - 40 Renown - [Briar's Kiss Signboard](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-xvi/maps/valisthea?locationIds=287608) (Memory Item) - The Breath of Light: Impulse (Accessory) - Meteorite x 1
